evidence.notes: W (concave, pool) face: framed glass field, flush floor lines, NE and SW ledgestone piers (8/9 cols, estimate), cream top band, darker top level, cantilevered roof slab. 16 typical floors x 3 blocks = INFERRED (fin count 16+-1; LiDAR 65 rows = 10 plinth + 48 + 3 frame band + 3 top level + 2 cornice). Lower ~10 rows poorly covered (podium terraces, palms).

E (convex) face, 2010 era: glass with a projecting fin every floor; a ledgestone pier group at bay 5 (~28-33% of u from the SW end, estimate) and the NE sign pier (last 2 bays, 16 cols, estimate). No lettering: the sign seen in 2010 ("red rock / CASINO", one line, lowercase) cannot be rendered faithfully in 3x5 block capitals on the pier, and the current sign is unresolved, so the pier is left as plain ledgestone.
SW (S) end, 2024: ledgestone with one vertical bronze bay strip (4 cols, estimate; position centred = inferred). The red letters high on this face are unreadable: no lettering placed.

Pool courtyard face (2013): cream stucco bands with recessed terraces and red sandstone pilasters; pilaster spacing 12 cols and band heights are estimates; the curved wood-soffit drum is not modelled.

NW casino entrance (2018, after the 2014 Charleston works). Position on this face from the Commons camera point and heading (estimate); the rest of the face is massing. The "CASINO" letters are not placed (not assigned). Yard House pylon not modelled.
